v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Mulíerem fortem quis invéniet? Procul et de últimis fínibus prétium eius. Confídit in ea cor viri sui, et spóliis non indigébit.
text.en: Who shall find a valiant woman? Far and from the uttermost coasts is the price of her. The heart of her husband trusteth in her, and he shall have no need of spoils.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis, allelúia.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips, alleluia.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum, allelúia.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever, alleluia.

text.la: Manum suam * apéruit ínopi, et palmas suas exténdit ad páuperem, et panem otiósa non comédit, allelúia.
text.en: She spreadeth out her hand to the poor, * yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy, and eateth not the bread of idleness, alleluia.

text.la: Deus, mæréntium consolátor et in te sperántium salus, qui beátæ Mónicæ pias lácrimas in conversióne fílii sui Augustíni misericórditer suscepísti: da nobis utriúsque intervéntu; peccáta nostra deploráre, et grátiæ tuæ indulgéntiam inveníre.
text.en: O God, the consoler of those Who mourn and the safety of those who put their trust in thee; Who mercifully accepted the holy tears of blessed Monica for the conversion of Augustine, her son; grant us through the intercession of both to bewail our sins and to obtain the grace of thy forgiveness.
